solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, one light wrong at 16 down, 27 across); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing; the grid proves the blog's answer wrong at 27 across, corrected here; clues and answers read from cryptics.georgeho.org (ODbL)'s copy of the post, which drops the counts, so each count is read off the blogger's answer

clue.text: There's cool cash around for folk in education

indicators.note: around here means scattered about, so the letters of the three words are set in a new order

parts.note: taken as its letters, the S of the contraction included

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that there is cool money going round for people who work in schools.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' looks like money circulating, but it is the signal to shuffle the fourteen letters before it; the S of the contraction counts.
explanation.definitionFit: Teachers in schools are the people whose working lives are spent in education.

clue.text: Work hard to acquire jam, in order to win the lady

parts.note: a jam is a tight spot, as is a scrape
taken as written
to win something is to get it
the lady referred to is her

explanation.surface: A suitor gets into a jam purely in order to win the lady's heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jam' reads as a verb but is the noun for a predicament.
explanation.definitionFit: To assemble money or resources with effort from scattered bits is a common idiom for laborious gathering.

clue.text: Army spy dropping off books for prisoner

parts.note: a host is a large army, as in the heavenly host

indicators.note: dropping off says some letters fall away from the spy word

parts.note: a secret agent is a spy
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: An army spy lets some books fall while a captive looks on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropping off' sheds the NT at the end of AGENT, leaving AGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A person held captive as security for terms is a captive, a kind of prisoner.

clue.text: One may get bather thus exhausted

parts.note: take the letters of breath and put them out of order, and one result is bather

explanation.surface: Someone who has worn themselves out ends up as a swimmer, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a reverse clue: read the answer as an instruction, with OUT OF signalling a rearrangement of BREATH, and it yields BATHER.
explanation.definitionFit: Being puffed and panting after exertion is the idiom for being exhausted.

clue.text: In attempt to circumvent death

indicators.note: to circumvent is to go round, so the attempt word surrounds the death word

parts.note: a try is an attempt
one's end is one's death

explanation.surface: Someone makes an attempt to cheat death.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' at the start looks like a preposition but is the definition, as in 'the in thing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is in is fashionable, the same as being modish and of the moment.

clue.text: Let off the hook, a slob finally cracked

indicators.note: finally points to the final letter of the slob word

parts.note: a cracked puzzle is one that has been solved

explanation.surface: A lazy layabout finally breaks down and is excused.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cracked' seems to describe the slob breaking down; it means a puzzle worked out.
explanation.definitionFit: To be let off the hook is to be freed from blame or obligation, i.e. forgiven or acquitted.

clue.text: Elated, we hear, to speed

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word for elated is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: someone elated is high

explanation.surface: We hear people are elated enough to rush along.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the old-fashioned verb meaning to hasten.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic verb for hurrying, still seen in phrases such as 'hie thee hence', means to hasten.

clue.text: Letter I redesigned and put new heading on

indicators.note: something redesigned is rebuilt in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A letter written in the first person is redrafted with a fresh title.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redesigned' rearranges the seven letters of LETTER I.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving a document or work a fresh heading is renaming it with a new caption.

clue.text: Tainted comedian reformed, one coming out cleaned up

indicators.note: reformed means formed anew, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A disgraced comic mends his ways and comes out squeaky clean.
explanation.walkthrough: A composite anagram: rearrange TAINTED COMEDIAN, then 'coming out' removes I (one) from the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: Something freed of harmful or polluting material has been purified, cleansed of contamination.

clue.text: Group into repetitive learning gets badge for achievement

indicators.note: into places the group word inside the learning word

parts.note: learning by rote is learning by repetition
a set is a group

explanation.surface: A class drilled by repetition earns a badge for its efforts.
explanation.definitionFit: A ribbon rosette is awarded as a prize at shows and competitions, marking an achievement.

clue.text: Two articles attached to book cover

parts.note: She is the novel by H. Rider Haggard
A is the indefinite article and the definite article is THE
A is the indefinite article and the definite article is THE

explanation.surface: Two articles stuck to a book form its cover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'book' is a specific title: She, Rider Haggard's adventure novel.
explanation.definitionFit: To put a blade in its scabbard is to encase or cover it.

clue.text: Request left out for a bit of food

indicators.note: out says the left letter is taken out of the request word

parts.note: a plea is a request

explanation.surface: A request for a scrap of food is left out.
explanation.definitionFit: A single legume seed, one of the smallest things served on a plate, is a morsel of food.

clue.text: Opera must have performers right for one head of state

indicators.note: must have says the opera holds the performers inside it
right for one means the right letter takes the place of the one letter

parts.note: Fidelio is Beethoven's only opera
the Roman numeral I is one
the cast are the performers in a show

explanation.surface: An opera needs singers who are right for a role as a head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: In FIDELIO swap the I for R (FIDELRO), then insert CAST.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cuban revolutionary led his country as prime minister and later president for decades.

clue.text: Like a sort of missile that's clue to a riot?

parts.note: read as wordplay, a riot ground up into fresh order gives the letters airto

explanation.surface: A puzzle asks what kind of missile provides the clue to a civil disturbance.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: the answer read as an instruction means A RIOT 'ground' (rearranged) into AIRTO.
explanation.definitionFit: A missile launched from an aircraft at a surface target is described by this compound adjective.

clue.text: The politician rejecting leader's principles (6) (A misprint in the online solve and print versions — whatever the misprint was, it is now correct BD)

indicators.note: rejecting the leader's place means the first letter of the politician is dropped

parts.note: a Tory is a British Conservative politician

explanation.surface: A politician rejects the party leader's principles.
explanation.definitionFit: A body of general principles that explains something is a set of ideas or doctrine.

clue.text: Make fresh adjustments to retire — no working!

indicators.note: working means being worked over, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone retiring must adjust to no longer being at work.
explanation.definitionFit: To align or adjust something anew is to set it in a fresh direction.

clue.text: Something used for cleaning toilet in station

parts.note: water is used for washing and cleaning
loo is British slang for a toilet

explanation.surface: A cleaning product is used on the toilet at a railway station.
explanation.walkthrough: London Waterloo is a major railway terminus.
explanation.definitionFit: The London rail terminus is one of Britain's best-known stations.

clue.text: Bit of radiation that's bright getting a male hurt internally

indicators.note: internally places the pieces inside the bright word

parts.note: gay in its older sense means bright and cheerful
to mar is to damage or hurt

explanation.surface: A cheerful type gets a man hurt, with radiation involved.
explanation.definitionFit: High-energy electromagnetic emissions from radioactive decay are a form of radiation.

clue.text: Wedded male regularly cuddling a woman

indicators.note: cuddling means holding around, so the pair of letters wraps the rest
regularly picks every other letter of the male word

parts.note: Rita is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A married man regularly hugs a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes M and L from MALE, which go around A RITA.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to marriage, the adjective describes what concerns a wedded couple.

clue.text: Decoration, high award given at end of ceremony

indicators.note: given at end of puts the award after the ceremony word

parts.note: pomp is splendid ceremony
OM is the Order of Merit, a high British honour

explanation.surface: A high honour is presented as a ceremony draws to a close.
explanation.definitionFit: A woollen ball or tuft is an ornament on hats or a cheerleader's prop.

clue.text: Location with nasty smell — dope found here isn't real

parts.note: a place is a location
BO is body odour

explanation.surface: A place reeks, and the drug found there turns out to be fake.
explanation.definitionFit: A dummy pill handed out as if it were medicine contains no active drug.

clue.text: Brandy lets one have good conversation with the old man

parts.note: a rap is a chat or conversation
one's old man is one's father, or pa

explanation.surface: A drink of brandy lets someone have a good talk with their father.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian spirit distilled from grape pomace is a kind of brandy.

clue.text: Hector, champion — is such a leader!

parts.note: the two names together hold the letters of a flame carried aloft, so they carry, or bear, it

explanation.surface: Hector, the champion of Troy, is held up as the very model of a leader.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: TORCH sits inside HecTOR CHampion, so those words are its BEARER; the answer read as a description fits the clue words.
explanation.definitionFit: One who carries the flame and inspires others is figuratively the head of a movement or cause.

clue.text: Girl taken over, former man having left

indicators.note: having left says the former and man words depart from the longer word

parts.note: a territory taken over by another country is annexed
an ex is a former partner
Ed is a man's name

explanation.surface: A girl is taken over by someone after her former man has left.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a common woman's given name, so it can stand for a girl.

clue.text: Awful lather when knight gets stuck in entrance

indicators.note: gets stuck in places the knight letter inside the scrambled letters
awful signals the letters are a mess and must be rearranged

parts.note: N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A dreadful foam forms when a knight wades in at the doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entrance' is the verb meaning to captivate, not a doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrance someone is to captivate or spellbind them.

clue.text: Racket made by ruffians dies away

indicators.note: away says the dies letters go from the ruffians word

parts.note: rowdies are rough, disorderly people

explanation.surface: The din made by hooligans fades away.
explanation.definitionFit: A racket is a noisy din, the same as a loud quarrel or uproar.

clue.text: Well-judged page introducing offensive section of scripture

indicators.note: introducing puts the page letter in front of the offensive word

parts.note: rude means offensive
NT is the New Testament, a section of the Bible

explanation.surface: A page introduces an offensive passage of the Bible, judged wise.
explanation.definitionFit: A sensible, careful decision is one showing good judgement and caution.

clue.text: Fluctuate as a hairdryer may do

definitions.meaning: to waver between enthusiasm and indifference
a hairdryer literally pushes out air on warm and cool settings

explanation.surface: Someone vacillates in the way a hairdryer alternates its settings.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes being inconsistent, swinging between keenness and coolness.
